headline: UK’s Josh Kerr smashes longstanding world mile record in London
context: Kerr ran a 3:42.66 mile at the London Diamond League, smashing Hicham El Guerrouj’s world record by 0.47 seconds.

sources.name: Al Jazeera

sources.summary: Kerr announced his bid to break the world record months in advance, and pulled off the plan in London on Saturday.
